items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: On the Rae-Cox Label, Tony Rice and the Overtones -- "Little School Girl" and "Bluebird Of Happiness."

ctx.x: There's the Butanes, Teddy McRae and Orchestra. "That's My Desire" and Don't Forget I Love You.
On the Rae-Cox Label, Tony Rice and the Overtones -- "Little School Girl" and "Bluebird Of Happiness."
"Little School Girl," you say you used to release it every year --
